title: Inclusion House Content Officer
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
A Local Council is seeking an organised and creative Inclusion House Content Officer to support the ongoing development of an innovative digital platform designed to provide young people, parents, carers, and professionals with easy access to information, resources and support services.

Inclusion House is an exciting digital initiative that aims to become a central hub of information and guidance for local communities. With several sections already developed and further expansion planned, this role will play a key part in ensuring content is engaging, consistent, accessible and aligned with the overall vision of the platform.

Working closely with the platform's project lead and a range of internal and external stakeholders, you will be responsible for managing, editing and maintaining content, ensuring a high-quality user experience across the site.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain and organise content across the Inclusion House platform.
- Edit and upload videos, presentations, graphics and other digital content provided by stakeholders.
- Review and refine content to ensure clarity, accessibility and consistency of messaging.
- Support the development and maintenance of the platform's branding and visual identity.
- Work closely with project leads and stakeholders to ensure content aligns with organisational objectives.
- Carry out quality assurance checks on all content before publication.
- Ensure all material meets agreed standards, branding guidelines and content criteria.
- Assist with workforce development, content and resource management across the platform.
- Monitor content updates and ensure information remains accurate and relevant.
- Liaise with contributors to coordinate content submissions and approvals.

About YouWe are looking for a creative and detail-oriented professional with experience managing digital content and supporting online platforms.

Essential Experience & Skills
- Experience working with digital platforms, websites, intranets or online content management systems.
- Strong content editing, proofreading and quality assurance skills.
- Experience working with digital media, including video, graphics and visual content.
- Understanding of branding, communications and content consistency.
- Ability to organise and manage multiple content streams from a variety of stakeholders.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent written communication skills.
- Experience using content management systems and digital publishing tools.
- Confident stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

Desirable Experience
- Experience within local government, education, SEND or community-focused services.
- Knowledge of accessibility requirements for digital content.
- Background in marketing, communications, digital media or content development.
- Experience supporting workforce development, learning or information-sharing platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity for a content professional with strong digital and communications skills who enjoy bringing structure, consistency and quality to online platforms while making a positive impact within a local authority setting. We'd love to hear from you, so please send your updated CV!

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Client Services Coordinator

Location: Harborne, Birmingham

Basic Salary: £26,000 + Bonuses

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am - 5:30pm

We're working with a growing independent estate agency looking for a Marketing & Client Services Coordinator to join their team.

This is a varied and exciting role combining property marketing, social media, content creation and client service.

The Role

You'll be involved in a wide range of activities, including:
- Preparing new properties for market, including property descriptions and floorplans
- Planning and creating social media content
- Writing blogs and local property content
- Coordinating direct-mail marketing campaigns
- Creating and repurposing video and property content
- Handling new enquiries and supporting existing clients
- Booking appointments and coordinating communication
- Bringing new ideas to improve the company's marketing and processes
- Managing multiple tasks, projects and deadlines

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Organized and highly detail-focused
- Confident communicating with people
- Creative with a good eye for engaging content
- Comfortable using technology and learning new systems
- Able to manage multiple priorities
- Proactive and full of ideas
- Keen to learn, develop and take ownership

Estate agency experience would be beneficial but is not essential. Full training will be provided on the property software, CRM, floorplans and internal processes.

Why Join?

This is a great opportunity to join an ambitious independent estate agency where you'll have the chance to make the role your own.

As the business grows, there will be opportunities to take on more responsibility and develop your career across marketing, client services and property.

The role is initially being recruited due to a maternity leave opening, with the potential for the right person to build a long-term career within the business.

Interested?

If you're organized, creative, confident and looking for a role where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Senior Internal Communications Manager
description:
Senior Internal Communications and Engagement Manager
Salary up to £64,562 + benefits
Birmingham based
Hybrid working 3 days onsite

My client is looking for an experienced Internal Communications and Engagement Manager to support in delivering their internal communications and engagement strategy, so that they can help employees understand how they successfully contribute to the companies purpose, and ensure everyone feels informed, valued and engaged.

Experience required:
- Experience at senior management level developing and delivering comprehensive, evidence-based internal communications and engagement strategies and plans aligned with wider business objectives.
- Experience working on large-scale transformation programmes and using change impact analysis to inform appropriate communication approach.
- Experience of developing and delivering engagement campaigns.
- Providing counsel on internal corporate communications and engagement to Executives and senior leaders across large, complex, fast-paced matrix organisations.
- Development, delivery, and measurement of internal communications and resources planning, defining the processes and structures required to achieve success.
- Experience delivering high quality engagement communications to agreed deadlines.

title: Communications and Marketing Manager - Fixed Term Contract 2 Years
description:
Closing Date: 27th September 2026

Interview Date: 8th October 2026

Corporate Band E

Salary : £38,413 rising to £39,908 in year two, subject to achieving objectives

Hours: Full Time, 37.5 hours

Fixed Term: 2 years until 31st December 2028, covering a secondment

Hybrid working with multi-site working from home and across both sites, Selly Park and Erdington

About the role

We are recruiting a Communications and Marketing Manager to support income growth through the delivery of Birmingham Hospice's income generation communications and marketing activity.

This is a two-year, fixed-term post covering a secondment - a genuine opportunity to make a lasting impact for a charity with ambitious plans for the future.

Working closely with income generation colleagues, you'll bring together fundraising, media, marketing, digital, creative and campaigns activity to maximise income, supporter acquisition and retention.

You'll be confident leading projects and working collaboratively across teams to deliver impactful campaigns through social media, email and paid media, bringing creativity, innovation and new ideas to help secure and grow all forms of voluntary income and raise the profile of Birmingham Hospice.

What you'll bring
- A background in a fundraising and/or communications environment
- A proven track record creating multimedia communications campaigns, including social media, email and paid digital advertising (e.g. Meta, Google, TikTok ads)
- Experience of developing and managing digital channels, including websites and a variety of social media platforms
- Some experience of line managing, mentoring or developing team members
- Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to manage a complex workload and prioritise effectively
- Creative thinking skills with the ability to spot opportunities for innovation and growth

What we offer
- Join a supportive, creative and collaborative team where your ideas are valued
- A varied and interesting role leading fundraising marketing, digital and campaigns activity
- Autonomy to try new things and bring innovation to your work
- Work that makes a genuine difference for people living with terminal illness and their families
- Recognition of prior NHS or hospice service (including pension and annual leave entitlements)
- Generous annual leave, wellbeing programmes and access to employee benefit platforms such as Stream and Engage
